channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
item.description: GPT-6 family models designed protein structures and sequences using only reasoning and code, and lab tests with Onava found that proteins from GPT-6.2 showed binding evidence across five targets, including redesigned antibodies that retained binding. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
item.description: Microduck's Sim2Real obstacle-avoidance workflow keeps the original walking policy fixed, models ToF sensing with Newton's raycaster, and trains an independent 50 Hz Isaac Lab controller to adjust gamepad velocity commands, covering training, evaluation, export, and real-robot deployment. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
item.description: Google Gemini has become the official AI assistant and enterprise LLM partner for the Warriors, Valkyries and Chase Center, powering custom AI agents and fan engagement, as announced on November 24, 2026. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: More predictable notifications on GitHub.com
item.description: GitHub.com begins a week-long notifications migration on December 1, 2026, making subscriptions follow current team membership, limiting the Subscriptions page to manual subscriptions, and displaying notification reasons in a fixed priority order. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
item.description: Two amateur astronomers used Codex to screen about 100,000 Kepler stars and Astra to analyze data from roughly 19 million stars, identifying potential exoplanets now sent to the SETI Institute and TESS team for review. (OpenAI News)

item.title: AI-generated worlds are no longer just visuals: Amap's ABot-World0.5 supports real-time interaction and audio generation
item.description: Amap's ABot-World0.5 adds attack, jump and driving interactions plus synchronized footsteps and engine sounds, lets users adjust plot and weather in natural language, and tops WBench's physics and overall rankings. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic adds "Install as App" to Claude Artifacts, letting AI-generated tools be installed on macOS and Windows desktops
item.description: On November 25 Anthropic launched a beta "Install as app" feature for Claude Artifacts, letting AI-generated tools run as standalone icons on macOS and Windows with layered controls for notifications and shortcut interception. (AIbase)

item.title: GPT-6 Enters the Arena Without a Dedicated Biology Model: 322 Designed Proteins Head to the Lab, About One in Ten Show Signs of Binding
item.description: OpenAI’s November 24 preprint reports that its GPT-6 series designed proteins without specialized biological models, with 35 of 322 (about 10.9%) showing binding signals in the lab, though screening still relied on tools such as Boltz-2. (AIbase)

item.title: Suspect in OpenAI wiretapping case granted bail: $1 million bond and electronic ankle monitor; judge says evidence insufficient to continue detention
item.description: Al-Fozan, accused of hiding a toilet-paper-wrapped recorder behind a TV in OpenAI’s San Francisco conference room, won $1 million bail on November 24 after Judge Alex Tse found evidence insufficient for continued detention, pending electronic ankle monitoring and home confinement. (AIbase)

item.title: Amateur astronomers use AI to scan 19 million stars, flagging potential exoplanet signals for expert verification
item.description: OpenAI's Nov. 24 blog reports amateur researchers using Codex and Astra, with Ethan Byrd scanning about 19 million stars to flag 49 potential exoplanet candidates now sent to professional astronomers for verification. (AIbase)

item.title: Closing the browser doesn't stop it from eating hundreds of megabytes of RAM! Chrome's hidden "AI memory assassin" has been exposed — here's one trick to free up those resources for good
item.description: Chrome can keep several processes holding 300MB to 700MB of memory after the browser window is closed, and this piece traces that behavior to the built-in Gemini AI keeping background processes alive for instant shortcut access, verified through cross-testing with fresh, signed-out profiles. (AIbase)

item.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia
item.description: Amazon’s reported $7.5 billion acquisition of Decart aims to boost the efficiency of its Trainium chips, illustrating a strategy of using software to narrow the hardware gap with Nvidia. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: Claude Ship — Ship code as fast as you can write it
item.description: Titled "Claude Ship" with the tagline "Ship code as fast as you can write it," the page returns only "Just a moment" and "Performing security verification," a CAPTCHA wall blocking access to any actual content. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Qwen Go opens its AI calling service to all users, with support for bookings, inquiries, and scheduled outbound calls
item.description: Alibaba's Qwen Go has fully opened an AI proxy calling service that, with user authorization, books restaurant private rooms, asks hotels about lost items, checks courier progress and schedules outbound calls while identifying itself as an AI assistant. (AIbase)

item.title: PenGPT：一种用于手写和草图生成的生成式变压器模型
item.description: PenGPT：一种用于手写和草图生成的生成式变压器模型 (greydanus.github.io)

item.title: Clam AI — Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
item.description: Clam AI's headline claim—sharing your inbox safely with AI agents—is all the page delivers: the body returns only a CAPTCHA verification screen, with no product details or data behind it. (Product Hunt)

item.title: No "AI junk code": LibreOffice unveils its strictest AI coding rules yet — use an LLM to write code and you must first pass a human explanation checkpoint
item.description: LibreOffice maintainer TDF sets four hard rules for LLM-assisted coding: AI patches must explain every changed line in the contributor’s own words, win approval and disclosure before submission, and cannot use LLMs for commit messages or comments. (AIbase)
